info.title: FFDB HTTP API
info.description: Versioned management, project SQL, authentication, sync, object-storage, email-template, and operations API. Error responses use a stable code/message/request_id envelope. Mutation routes marked with x-ffdb-idempotency require an Idempotency-Key header.

get.description: Public first-run discovery. Reports whether an owner and deployment mode are configured and which paid modes this build can activate; never returns credentials.
Return the authenticated actor's instance configuration and administration capabilities.

post.description: Complete first-run setup or atomically change the owner-controlled deployment and platform-billing mode. Non-canceled organization billing accounts lock the instance to its current mode and Stripe account; unsafe changes fail with instance.billing_in_use until every subscription is canceled and reconciled.

get.description: Return retained request, query-fingerprint, worker, and storage telemetry for the entire instance or an optional project. Requires an instance owner or administrator session. Raw SQL, identifiers, comments, literals, and parameter values are never returned or retained.

Inspect signed release availability, compatibility evidence, capabilities, settings, and the active durable host-update job. An unsupported installation is returned as a readable supported=false state.

post.description: Queue a signed-release availability check. No client-controlled URL or executable input is accepted.
Queue installation of one exact signed FFDB release. Requires authentication performed in the previous 15 minutes.
Queue rollback to an installed, compatibility-approved signed release. Requires authentication performed in the previous 15 minutes.

get.description: Read durable host-update progress before or after an API restart.

patch.description: Queue a validated update-policy change. Automatic apply is opt-in and requires a bounded recurring UTC maintenance window. Requires authentication performed in the previous 15 minutes.

post.description: Create or resume Stripe Connect onboarding for the platform merchant account.
Refresh Connect readiness and provision or validate the instance billing catalog.

patch.description: Disable or re-enable an organization globally without deleting its durable state.
Disable or re-enable a platform account. The immutable instance owner cannot be disabled.

200.description: Organization subscription selection and effective entitlements

get.description: List durable local invoice records reconciled with the configured platform billing provider.
Return the current reads, writes, byte-hours/GB-month, and MAU ledger totals and allowance position.

200.description: Verified event accepted or safely deduplicated

get.description: Compatibility capability summary. Use the /commerce routes for complete project-commerce administration.

200.description: Project commerce provider and capability summary
Write-only credential configuration status and provider capabilities

delete.description: Remove an unused local BYO or Connect binding and its encrypted project secrets. Returns commerce.account_in_use when provider-bound commerce data exists; it never closes the external Stripe account.

201.description: Short-lived project Stripe Customer Portal redirect

post.description: BYO-only endpoint. Connect events are rejected and must use the global account-routed Connect endpoint.

200.description: Verified BYO event processed or deduplicated

post.description: Global Stripe Connect endpoint. FFDB verifies the deployment's project-Connect endpoint secret before parsing event.account, resolves exactly one connected project, and enforces that account and livemode binding.

200.description: Verified account-routed Connect event processed or deduplicated

parameters.name: wait_ms
parameters.description: Hold an otherwise-idle authenticated pull until a project change hint arrives or the timeout elapses.

201.description: Provider multipart upload created and durably committed

200.description: Restore completed and verified by the isolated database worker

get.description: Return retained request, privacy-safe normalized query-fingerprint, worker, and storage telemetry for one project. Any member of the owning organization may read this operational view.

projectBearer.description: Project end-user JWT or scoped developer API key as permitted by the route.

StripeSignature.name: Stripe-Signature
StripeSignature.description: Stripe HMAC signature over the exact raw request body.

ObservabilityRange.name: range
ObservabilityRange.description: Retained time window. Server-selected chart resolution keeps responses bounded.

ObservabilitySummary.description: Bounded retained operational telemetry. Query shapes are structurally normalized and never contain raw SQL identifiers, comments, literals, or parameter values.

route.description: Stable route template; concrete project and resource IDs are excluded.

fingerprint.description: SHA-256 of the privacy-safe normalized query shape.

shape.description: Bounded SQL structure with identifiers, comments, literals, and parameters replaced.
